summary.text: Constance Menzies is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Sade Elhawary (D).
An educator, she describes herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a mother, community leader, postal worker, nurse and caregiver.

paragraphs.text: Constance Menzies graduated from Evan's Adult High School, earned an associate degree from Los Angeles Trade-Technical College in 2005, and received a bachelor's degree in 2008 and a graduate degree in 2012, both from the University of Phoenix.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said her roles have included School Site President, Enrichment Leader and Supervisor Aide, as well as work in health care, education and public service.
Menzies listed public safety and strong communities, affordability for working families, and education and opportunity as her three key campaign messages.
She said she supports law enforcement, reducing unnecessary regulations, small businesses, parental involvement in schools and workforce training.
